messages:
marta: Working on the changelog draft for the Dedicated autoscale improvements and the VPC migration guide. PR #3380 is live. Need snippet sanity checks for Python and JS, and a quick link-health sweep before we publish. ping @ben @tom :wave:
ben: I'll take the SDK snippets. Noticed the Python sample still references `from redwood import Client` which is legacy. Switching to `from redwood import RedwoodClient` in the snippet. Will push a tiny refactor commit.
tom: I'll run link checks. Found that `/guides/dedicated#autoscale?policy=aggressive` gets normalized to `/guides/dedicated#autoscale` on prod, which breaks a few telemetry links. Recommending we add a short "anchor compat" blurb in the migration guide.
sai: On the VPC migration note: customers who use network policies need to add `allow: egress: 443` in their config example. Added a code block in the draft, please verify wording.
jules: Heads-up: discovered a subtle UX wording problem in the changelog title — "Autoscale tuning" reads like product config rather than best-practice guidance. Suggest rename: "Autoscale: recommended policies and migration notes".
marta: Good call, @jules. Update the title in the PR, and add a 1-line cross-ref to the Optimize docs. Also, @ben please make the Python snippet backwards-compatible note: "If you upgraded from older SDK releases, replace Client(...) with RedwoodClient(...)". Keep it short.
ben: Patch pushed to #3380: ```diff
- from redwood import Client
- client = Client(api_key)
+ from redwood import RedwoodClient
+ client = RedwoodClient(api_key=api_key)
```
ben: Also adding an extra JS snippet showing await client.streamEmbeddings(...) usage. Running `npm run lint` locally.
docs-bot: Docs staging deploy scheduled for 2024-07-30T03:00Z. Blockers: outstanding UX approval, missing screenshot for migration step 2. CI status: tests passing, 2 flaky link checks.
tom: I ran `scripts/check-links.sh staging` and the only failures are anchor normalizations and an old redirect from `/changelog#whatsnew` -> 404. I filed docs#1236 for the redirect.
sai: Reworded the VPC config example to emphasize the egress port. Added a minimal YAML snippet: ```yaml
network_policies:
  egress:
    - port: 443
      to: redwood-inference.internal
```
jules: I added the screenshot (step 2) and uploaded to the PR. Also applied the title change.
marta: Product asked to include a one-sentence known issue: "Some customers may observe duplicated webhook events during retry storms; we recommend idempotent handlers keyed by idempotency_key." Keep it phrased as guidance.
\enotes: (typo note)
ben: small nit: change "idempotency_key" -> "idempotency_key (request-level)" for clarity.
marta: updated. Can someone confirm the JS streaming example isn't using deprecated `.on('data')` handler? We prefer async iterators now.
ben: Confirmed. Updated snippet to async iterator style: ```js
for await (const chunk of client.streamEmbeddings({input: text})) {
  processChunk(chunk)
}
```
docs-bot: Reminder: release checklist incomplete 14; missing: localization flags, UX signoff, smoke test on staging.
tom: I'll run the anchor smoke test after staging deploy and post results.
sai: Opened docs#1237 to whitelist critical anchors for short-term compatibility. Tests added.
marta: Plan: merge PR after UX signoff and staging smoke test. If anchors still fail post-deploy, we'll add a short "anchor migration" note at the top of the page and open a rollback for the relnote. Thanks all. :rocket:
